data.one_liner: Helper package to define type-safe paths for go_router and other routers without hardcoded strings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a structured way to define navigation paths, parameters, and query strings in one central location. It removes the need for hardcoded string paths throughout your application and handles URI encoding automatically.
use_when: You want to avoid hardcoded route strings in your GoRouter configuration
You need a type-safe and structured way to handle path parameters and query strings
avoid_when: You prefer code generation for your routes
You do not use go_router or similar path-based navigation packages
strengths: Provides helper classes for parameters and child routes
weaknesses: Requires manual class setup for every path structure
Does not generate routes automatically via build_runner

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a robust, code-generated routing solution with type-safe arguments out of the box.

alternatives.name: go_router_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses code generation to type-check go_router parameters and routes natively.
